title: Molecular Mechanisms and Gene Regulatory Potential of Rutin: A Hypothesis-Driven Approach for Precision Medicine Applications.
snippet: Rutin, is a naturally occurring flavonoid found in Ruta graveolens L., and preclinical evidence suggests its potential to regulate oxidative stress, suppress inflammation, and modulate intracellular signaling pathways.
